Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. This effect requires you to activate a [When Digivolving] effect if present on the placed Digimon card.
Card Q&A.q: Can I choose to not activate a [When Digivolving] effect on the placed Digimon card for this card's [When Attacking] effect?
Can I use this card’s [When Attacking] effect to place 1 level 4 card with [Pulsemon] in its text that doesn't have a [When Digivolving] effect as a digivolution card?

Effect: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] By placing 1 level 4 card with [Pulsemon] in its text from your hand as this Digimon's bottom digivolution card, activate 1 [When Digivolving] effect on the placed card as an effect of this Digimon.
[Your Turn] While you have a Tamer, this Digimon gets +3000 DP.
